nuggets.text: After Syracuse beat Cal 33-25 in 2024, Fran Brown, who skips showers after losses, declared: 'Winners get washed!'
Shavane Anderson Jr. ran for 102 yards and three touchdowns in his Syracuse debut, a 66-3 rout of New Hampshire.
Steve Angeli's first college start came for Notre Dame in the 2023 Sun Bowl: 232 yards and three touchdowns.
Fran Brown set Camden High's record with 47 touchdown passes as a quarterback before becoming a cornerback.
Syracuse University's ZIP code is 13244, a nod to the No. 44 worn by Jim Brown, Ernie Davis and Floyd Little.
The Orange mascot became Otto in 1990; performers rejected the name Opie because it rhymed with 'dopey.'
The JMA Wireless Dome is the largest domed stadium on any college campus.
The Dome's 'Loud House' nickname was coined on opening night in 1980, when sound echoed off its inflatable roof.
Umari Hatcher caught eight passes for 147 yards and two touchdowns in the Orange's opener.
Syracuse's Ernie Davis became the first African American to win the Heisman Trophy, in 1961.
